title: 🔆🔅Zahedan -September 16th - Funeral procession of Molavi Yousef Gorgij in Zahedan, Iran.
text:
🔆🔅Zahedan -September 16th - Funeral procession of Molavi Yousef Gorgij in Zahedan, Iran."

"On 14 September 2026, he was assassinated by unidentified gunmen outside his home in Zahedan. He was the second Sunni cleric killed in the province this year."

"His funeral was held this morning, September 16th with a large procession of mourners. The body was carried from Imam Hossein Square to the Martyrs' Cemetery (Golzar-e Shohada) in Zahedan."

"Molavi Yousef Gorgij was a prominent Sunni cleric and the Friday prayer leader of the Mohammad Rasulullah Mosque in Zahedan, the capital of Sistan and Baluchestan Province. He was widely known as an influential figure in promoting Shia-Sunni unity in the region."

"People chanting in Farsi: "My dear martyred brother, we will continue you path.
